# Workflow builder and UX screenshots

All screenshots use Brutalist light. Workflow drafts are local examples; the Issues screenshots deliberately show an invalid route and its suggested fix. Run graph and timeline screenshots render the actual renderer/components with labelled synthetic data, not executed agent workflows.
